description: GOOGLE_SHEET_TAB was overwritten with a tab gid during Sprint 1; the Sheets values API addresses ranges by tab name, not gid, so a gid silently breaks reads. Document the env contract (which vars hold names vs ids, the tab-name-vs-gid distinction) in the project docs / .env.example so it is not re-confused.
title: Document the env contract for GOOGLE_SHEET_TAB (name, not gid)
acceptance_criteria: The env contract for GOOGLE_SHEET_TAB (tab name, not gid) is documented where devops will see it
.env.example reflects the correct shape with a clarifying comment
